The take. Head goes, comes back. PURE tier 1-3 - one expression and two ad-hoc `parts` transforms on `head`, which ToonRigRepair guarantees exists on every character rig along with body/mouth/eyes and six synthesised face_* poses. So this casts on every character that will ever be made: no rig authoring, no new art, no clip. It is the cheapest possible demonstration that the cheap tier is real.

The head does not fly apart - it is scaled to nothing under a burst. Nobody animates skull fragments in limited animation; the FX and the sound carry it, which is the whole economics of the form.
